quests.name: Sailor, Gwang-Chun's Favor
quests.description: Sailor, Gwang-Chun must go to the south with the goods but his servant is disappeared and the goods couldn't get on board. Please deliver Gwang-Chun's goods.

quests.name: Message Collection
quests.description: A secret message to the castle has been handed to the demons. Take it back and keep the national secret.

quests.name: Grasp the Situation of Demons
quests.description: A rumor that the demons will attack here but we don't have enough troops to defend ourselves so we need to grasp the situation of demons.

quests.name: General, Poong-seup's Missing
quests.description: Farmer, Ji-hun asked you for finding the general, Poong-seup.

quests.name: Farmer, Nu-Woong's Favor
quests.description: Get the money from the miner, Ghee-Sik and give' em back to the farmer, Nu-Woong.

quests.name: Farmer, Ha-Jik's Favor
quests.description: Farmer, Ha-Jik give some rice to the farmer, Nu-Woong. Inquire that the rice's arrived safely.

quests.name: Won-Jung and Yae-Jin's Love
quests.description: The guard, Won-Jung ask you to give a letter to his wife, Yae-Jin.

quests.name: Sweeping the Demon carcass scavenger
quests.description: Sweep all the Demon carcass scavenger who revive the demons.

quests.name: Finding Tonic
quests.description: Find the tonic for restoring the injured soldier's health.

quests.name: Finding Alcohol for Joo-Nong
quests.description: A miner, Joo-Nong wants some alcohol.

quests.name: Undelivered Rice Cake
quests.description: I haven't received the rice cake that I ordered. Find out what happened.

quests.name: Wa-Ryu's Talisman
quests.description: Wa-Ryu has lost the talisman that is from his wife and he kicked out of his home. Find Wa-Ryu's talisman.

quests.name: Finding Yae-Jin's Father
quests.description: Yae-Jin's father's not returning home for a half year. Find out the father.

quests.name: Collecting Yang-Do's Bamboo Poles
quests.description: The guard, Yang-Do said his bamboo pole has taken away. Find out the bamboo pole.

quests.name: Finding the Statue of Protection
quests.description: Go to the miner, Ghee-sik. He'll tell you that the Statue of Protection is taken by the demons. Find the Statue of Protection.

quests.name: Ja-Gan's Good Conduct
quests.description: The famous stingy Ja-Gan wants to help the poor. Help him.

quests.name: Getting Red Flags
quests.description: Go to the general, Sae-Won and he'll give you a mission that you take the demons red flags away.

quests.name: Beheading the Demon Water Dragon
quests.description: Go to the general, Sae-Won and he'll ask you to bring the Demon water dragon's head for improving the morale.

quests.name: Demon's Drum
quests.description: Go to the general, Sae-Won and he'll ask you to bring the demon's drum which makes demoralized.

quests.name: Collecting Armors
quests.description: Go to the chief and he'll tell you that they are short in supply of armors.

quests.name: Collecting Clothes that are Stained with Blood
quests.description: Go to the guard, Won-Jung and he'll ask you to collect the friends' clothes from the people who died in the battle.

quests.name: Materials of Winter Clothes
quests.description: Go to the chief guard, Guh-Sosun and he'll ask you to bring the demon water dragon's skin for the material of winter clothes.

quests.name: Hunting the Demon Mad Knight
quests.description: Go to the general, Sae-Won and he'll ask you for hunting the Demon mad knight.

quests.name: Helping Yang-Do
quests.description: Go to the guard, Yang-Do and he'll ask you for getting a secret letter of the demons.

quests.name: Joong-Gwon's Disease
quests.description: Meet the miner, Gwee-Sik and he'll tell you about Joong-Gwon that how he became deaf.

quests.name: Moon-Hee Who Became a Ghost
quests.description: Moon-Hee's mother told you about the story of her son Moon-Yoo who lost his mind. Help Moon-Yoo and Moon-Hee's mother.

quests.name: Hunting Ghost
quests.description: The ghost appeared with the deep fog took the Heung-Pae's Necklace of Wolf's Tooth and gave you fear.

quests.name: Bead of Ghost
quests.description: The Chief Guard, Duk-Yoon tells you why the ghost haunts and how to purify the Bead of Ghost. Purify the ghosts and send them to their world.

quests.name: Ghost of Blacksmith
quests.description: The Guard, Soo-Go ask you to purify the Bead of Blacksmith.

quests.name: Ghost of Friends
quests.description: The Guard, Dan-Bok ask you to send the ghosts who were his friends when they were alive to their world.

quests.name: Undetected Ghost
quests.description: The Guard, Ga-Gee told you the story about destroyed troops of Ghum-Ohee Castle and asked you to identify the undetected Ghost.

quests.name: Dilemma of Jae-Ga Troop's Scouts
quests.description: The Guard, Soo-Sung told you about the dilemma of the Scouts and ask you to purify the Sealed Ghost Troop.

quests.name: Devil Soldier with Bow
quests.description: The Soldier, Yoo-Sang in Jae-Ga troops, ask you to eliminate the Devil Soldier Bow around the Geum-Ohee Castle.

quests.name: Lim-Gang's Favor
quests.description: The Soldier, Lim-Gang in Jae-Ga troops, wants to have Devil Soldier's Spear.

quests.name: Dutiful Son and His Father
quests.description: My dutiful son haste left home for long time and he never come back. But it's odd that there's someone who bring the medicine and meats that helps the disease of his father, To-Woo.

quests.name: [Mission for Getting Ancient Animal] Doggebi, Chang's Favor
quests.description: Doggebi, Chang who take care of ancient animals worries that he lost a keg of talisman. The keg of talisman is needed to take care of ancient animals and if the Chang's master knows about this, Chang will be in trouble. Help Chang.

quests.name: Favor of Gi-Jung, the Chief of the Volunteer Army of Justice
quests.description: The Volunteer Army of Justice finds and punishes the corrupt government officers for the country. The man in front of you is the chief of the Volunteer Army of Justice and he asks you for a help.

quests.name: Eliminating Devil Troop of Pain
quests.description: Because the number of Devil Troops is increasing, we're having a hard time to eliminate them. Help them.

quests.name: Eliminating Devil Troop of Greed
quests.description: Because the number of Devil Troops is increasing, we're having a hard time to eliminate them. Help them.

quests.name: Eliminating Devil Troop of Jealousy
quests.description: Because the number of Devil Troops is increasing, we're having a hard time to eliminate them. Help them.

quests.name: Eliminating Devil Troop of Hatred
quests.description: Because the number of Devil Troops is increasing, we're having a hard time to eliminate them. Help them.

quests.name: Eliminating Devil Troop of Madness
quests.description: Because the number of Devil Troops is increasing, we're having a hard time to eliminate them. Help them.

quests.name: A Favor of the Doggebi Who Wants To Be a Friend with Humans
quests.description: There's a Doggebi who wants to be a friend with humans but he worries about something. He was making a doll for hunman children but the Devil Troop took it away. Help him.

quests.name: Seoung-Gill Who is Wandering the World
quests.description: Seoung-Gill who became a ghost and wanders around ask you to listen to him. He told you that he didn't kill Yong-Chun but the people think he did so he looked for the real murderer in the Forest of Statues and he was killed by the Devil Troops.

quests.name: Escape of Hak-Goo
quests.description: Hak-Goo who was patrolling the Geum-Ohee Castle was surrounded by the Devil Soldiers. He tried to escape from them but accidentally the Devil Soldiers took his rope and he can't climb down from the castle. Help Hak-Goo.

quests.name: The Limper's Favor
quests.description: A man who became a Limper from the result in a wrestling with the Doggebi with Monster Face wants to get a Broom and some Blood of the Big Handed for curing his wounds.

quests.name: The Blind Man's Favor
quests.description: A man who became blind from the result in a wrestling with the Doggebi. Help him.

quests.name: The Coward
quests.description: There's a wrestling champion who became coward by the spell of Doggebi. Dispel it.

quests.name: The Hunchback's Favor
quests.description: There's a man who became hunchbacked from the result in a wrestling with the Doggebi. Help him.

quests.name: The Deaf Man's Favor
quests.description: There's a man who became deaf from the result in a wrestling with the Doggebi. Help him.

quests.name: One-Armed Man's Favor
quests.description: One-armed man asked you to dispel the Doggebi's spell. Please help him.

quests.name: Legend of the Oh-Do Canyon Bridge
quests.description: The manager of the Oh-Do Canyon Bridge said that the bridge got Guardian Doggebi's spell and it must get maintenance during the raining season. Please help him.

quests.name: Eliminating The Demon Vulgar
quests.description: The Guard wants you to get a Demon Vulgar's head with using the beheading skill.

quests.name: Eliminating The Demon Scout
quests.description: The Guard wants you to get a Demon Scout's head with using the run skill.

quests.name: Eliminating The Demon Spear
quests.description: The Guard wants you to get a Demon Spear's head with using the rest skill.

quests.name: Fish Trap Installation
quests.description: The Guard want you to catch a Goby with the fish trap.

quests.name: The Dead People Around The Tomb(1)
quests.description: The Spirits of the Royal Tomb came out of the Tomb. Ja-Sang wants you to meet the Tomb manager and find out what's happening in the Tomb. Maybe the Tomb manager will give you a new task.

quests.name: The Dead People Around The Tomb(2)
quests.description: The Tomb manager must seal the Deads and asked you to eliminate the Skeleton Warriors with the Spears.

quests.name: The Dead People Around The Tomb(3)
quests.description: The Tomb manager must seal the Deads and asked you to eliminate the Ministers of the Royal Tomb.

quests.name: The Dead People Around The Tomb(4)
quests.description: The Tomb manager must seal the Deads and asked you to eliminate the Maid of Honor of the Royal Tomb.

quests.name: The Dead People Around The Tomb(5)
quests.description: The Tomb manager must seal the Deads and asked you to eliminate The Royal Tomb Keeper with Sword.

quests.name: The Dead People Around The Tomb(6)
quests.description: The Tomb manager must seal the Deads and asked you to eliminate The Royal Tomb Keeper with Shield.

quests.name: The Dead People Around The Tomb(7)
quests.description: The Tomb manager must seal the Deads and asked you to eliminate The Royal Tomb Keeper with Spear.

quests.name: The Dead People Around The Tomb(8)
quests.description: The Tomb manager must seal the Deads and asked you to eliminate The Royal Tomb Keeper with Iron Hammer.

quests.name: Event quest (title unavailable)
quests.description: The configured objective is retained. Its title and current availability are unconfirmed.

quests.name: [Event] Beginning of Long Journey
quests.description: You were the chief of a troop and your entire troops lost from the battle even the lord. You lost your memory since you lost the war but you saved your life by Chun-Sooin's help.

quests.name: [Event] Appointment of General In-Pill
quests.description: The general, In-Pill won on a lot of battles as a good leader. He is also admired and trusted by the people. Now he's looking for some soldiers who have good abilities in Jook-Suh Cargo Station. It's a good chance for you to fight with the demons.

quests.name: [Event] Favor of the Governor of Geum-Ohee Castle
quests.description: The general, In-Pill ask you to do the favor of the governor of Geum-Ohee Castle. Do the favor of the Governor of Geum-Ohee Castle for the general, In-Pill.

quests.name: [Event] Entering the Government Service!
quests.description: By the HyungJoo-SeungGong's recommendation, you enter the government service. Meet the lord, Jin-Pyung in Geum-Oh Mine. He'll help you to enter the government service.

quests.name: [Event] Afterimage of Red Feather
quests.description: With the Lord, Jin-Pyung's help, you got a government position and you found out the Red Feather in your memory. Lord, Jin-Pyung asked you to meet Mr. Hyun-Choong in Geum-Ohee Castle.

quests.name: [Event] Evil Mind of Ban-go
quests.description: Jin-HaeryangÀÌ The general, Gwa-bo was a strong general when he was alive. The Red Feather and the Red Flag of Gwa-bo are not defined yet.

quests.name: [Event] Green of Doggebi Forest
quests.description: The war between the Devil Troops who invade the Forest of Statues(Doggebi Forest) and the Doggebis are getting bigger and bigger. Doggebis are starting to attack humans now. The demons absorb the power of the forest by using the Devil Troops' power. The power of the forest is the source of Doggebis' power. We have to stop the Devil Troops.

quests.name: [Event] Angry Doggebi Troop
quests.description: Jae-Ga tells you that the Doggebi Master needs your help. They're threatening race for human but Doggebis love peace and dance for a long time. You can find out why Doggebis are turned by meeting the Master Doggebi.

quests.name: [Event] New Government Position!
quests.description: You completed all the missions from Master Doggebi. Now, you can go back to Jae-Ga and report your missions.

notes: Classic uses the May 2006 client and the preserved server configuration. Historical private-server edits exist; this is not a claim that every setting matches the official launch server.
Monster populations are configured group limits. The server attempts to replenish a group on its cycle; these are not live counts or timers starting after a kill.
Monster models illustrate the species. Their individual positions are examples within the configured area.
Quests, services and travel can depend on character progress. Unverified links remain unavailable.
The red rejected-cell layer follows the server’s collision bits and monster-spawn exclusion flag. It describes configured eligibility, not current occupancy.
Loot labelled as quest or event loot requires the relevant objective. Drop probabilities are not inferred from numeric weights.
Collision-only objects do not have a visible appearance. They remain part of the coverage inventory; missing visual assets are counted separately.
Some recorded loot has no verified name. It remains listed as unidentified; it is not merged with a named item.
3 configured placements have an unresolved map or floor. They remain searchable and have not been moved to another location.
